messages:
Alex M: Heads up — cutoff for this sprint's release notes is today 17:00 PT. Please add a changelog entry to your PR or paste a short note here.

ReleaseBot: Automated reminder: release notes cutoff in 2 hours. See #eng-releases for details. :bell:

Priya S: Quick q — can an entry be multiple bullet lines if it's a bigger change?

Alex M: Short answer: yes, but prefer a 1-line summary + 1 brief context line if needed. Keep entries scannable.

Leo K: Pinging owners: any PRs that touch runtime/config need explicit version bumps. If you modify a public API, use a minor bump.

Jess R: Process reminder: add the changelog entry, then include the version bump in the same PR when possible. If not, open a follow-up PR and link it like "changelog: add entry (PR #1234)" and tag @release-manager.

Sam T: I can land a quick GH Action to validate the changelog entry shape (headers + bullet format) — will open a PR now. That should cut down manual format fixes.

Alex M: Thanks Sam. For now, use this informal template when adding entries:

```
### Added
- component: short one-line summary. (PR #1234) @owner

### Changed
- component: concise note. (PR #2345) @owner

### Fixed
- component: bug description. (PR #3456) @owner
```

Alex M: Rules: keep each bullet <= 2 lines, start with component tag, add PR number and @owner. Use "Added/Changed/Fixed" sections under Unreleased.

Jess R: If you can't make the cutoff, add the label `release/missed` and we'll triage for the next patch. Do not drop last-minute verbose long-form notes — we can link longer docs from the bullet.

DeployBot: Deploy freeze will activate at 17:30 PT. All merges after freeze may be deferred to the next window.

Priya S: Added entry to PR #5678 and bumped package.json. @Jess R please review.

Jess R: Reviewing now :eyes:

Sam T: Opened GH Action PR -> #890. It checks for header presence and a bullet pattern. Hoping to have it merged before the next release.

Alex M: Awesome — thanks everyone. Small follow-ups: squash tiny formatting fixes into author PRs and avoid separate "chore: changelog" PRs unless bumping versions. :tada:

Leo K: Noted. Will coordinate branch-freeze backouts if needed.

Alex M: Closing thread — ping me directly if there's an urgent blocker for release notes.
